environment: node test runner, python3, cli-runner scratch repos, attack-corpus (130 argv-safe entries); no product code changed

cases.title: The pr preflight samples one state branch named sdlc/state-<14 digits>; the stack preflight samples none; a custom format changes the prefix only
cases.given: A scratch git repo built by cli-runner with a controlled environment
cases.when: branches.py preflight runs with the mode, flags and config the scenario names
cases.then: The samples hold the kinds the spec table allows for that mode
cases.expected: The pr preflight samples one state branch named sdlc/state-<14 digits>; the stack preflight samples none; a custom format changes the prefix only
cases.actual: pr samples: slice, state (sdlc/state-20261010101651), e2e. stack samples: run, milestone, slice. Custom config format feature/{name} and --format x/{name} gave feature/state-<14 digits> and x/state-<14 digits>. Stack with custom format: no state.

cases.title: mr and direct preflights sample no state kind, with and without --branch
cases.given: A scratch git repo built by cli-runner with a controlled environment
cases.when: branches.py preflight runs with the mode, flags and config the scenario names
cases.then: The samples hold the kinds the spec table allows for that mode
cases.expected: mr and direct preflights sample no state kind, with and without --branch
cases.actual: mr without --branch: no samples. mr with --branch: one working sample only. direct: no samples in both cases.

cases.title: Only stack samples run and milestone, and both follow the branch format
cases.given: A scratch git repo built by cli-runner with a controlled environment
cases.when: branches.py preflight runs with the mode, flags and config the scenario names
cases.then: The samples hold the kinds the spec table allows for that mode
cases.expected: Only stack samples run and milestone, and both follow the branch format
cases.actual: stack: sdlc/run-1, sdlc/M-1. pr, mr, direct: no run or milestone. With feature/{name}: feature/run-1, feature/M-1.

cases.title: Only pr samples an e2e branch
cases.given: A scratch git repo built by cli-runner with a controlled environment
cases.when: branches.py preflight runs with the mode, flags and config the scenario names
cases.then: The samples hold the kinds the spec table allows for that mode
cases.expected: Only pr samples an e2e branch
cases.actual: pr: sdlc/M-1-e2e (feature/M-1-e2e with a custom format). stack, mr, direct: no e2e sample.

cases.title: No mode samples e2e-area, verify or attempt, also with hostile --branch, --format and config branchFormat values
cases.given: A scratch git repo built by cli-runner with a controlled environment
cases.when: branches.py preflight runs with the mode, flags and config the scenario names
cases.then: The samples hold the kinds the spec table allows for that mode
cases.expected: No mode samples e2e-area, verify or attempt, also with hostile --branch, --format and config branchFormat values
cases.actual: Plain run: each mode held only its allowed kinds. 130 attack-corpus entries run as --branch (4 modes), --format (pr) and config branchFormat (stack): no traceback, no new kind in any sample.

seeds.title: verify: hostile sweep of preflight is slow
seeds.detail: Each cli-runner call takes about 0.25 s, so the 130-entry sweep over 4 modes takes about 144 s. A smaller corpus subset would run faster.
